data.descEn: My Transition Seminar (MTS) aims to prepare CAF members for post-military life. Presentations typically include information on pensions, financial planning, Veterans Affairs Canada (VAC), and an overview of a variety of release administration and benefits. Day one is for both medical and general release; day two is for medical only.
